_about: Public-domain E. V. Gerhart (Emanuel Vogel Gerhart, 1817-1904, German Reformed, Mercersburg and Lancaster) for the Word Hoard: Institutes of the Christian Religion, 2 vols. (1891, 1894, introduction by Philip Schaff), Lectures on the Heidelberg Catechism (1891) and three addresses and discourses (1842-1858), raw Internet Archive OCR. Mercersburg theology; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 19 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

gerhart-institutes-1: Institutes of the Christian Religion, vol. 1, with an introduction by Philip Schaff (New York: A. C. Armstrong, 1891)
gerhart-institutes-2: Institutes of the Christian Religion, vol. 2 (New York: Funk & Wagnalls, 1894)
gerhart-heidelberg-lectures: Lectures on the Heidelberg Catechism (Lancaster, Pa.: Lecture Printing Society of the Theological Seminary, 1891)
gerhart-religion-science: Relation of Religion to Science: An Address at Marshall College (Chambersburg: German Reformed Church, 1842)
gerhart-vocation-scholar: The Proper Vocation of a Scholar: An Address (Mercersburg: Journal Office, MDCCCXLVII)
gerhart-great-tribulation: Blessedness of Those Who Pass through Great Tribulation: A Discourse Occasioned by the Death of Aaron B. Dundore (Lancaster: Theo. Fenn, 1858; preached November 29, 1857)
